mapper.select: SELECT u.*, r.role_name FROM users u LEFT JOIN user_roles ur ON u.user_id = ur.user_id LEFT JOIN roles r ON ur.role_id = r.role_id
SELECT u.*, r.role_name FROM users u LEFT JOIN user_roles ur ON u.user_id = ur.user_id LEFT JOIN roles r ON ur.role_id = r.role_id WHERE u.username = #{username}
SELECT u.*, r.role_name FROM users u LEFT JOIN user_roles ur ON u.user_id = ur.user_id LEFT JOIN roles r ON ur.role_id = r.role_id WHERE u.user_id = #{userId}

SELECT u.*, r.role_name FROM users u LEFT JOIN user_roles ur ON u.user_id = ur.user_id LEFT JOIN roles r ON ur.role_id = r.role_id WHERE auth_provider = #{provider} AND provider_user_id = #{providerUserId} -- LIMIT 1

SELECT user_id AS userId, username, password, email, full_name AS fullName, is_active AS isActive, avatar_url AS avatarUrl, auth_provider AS authProvider, provider_user_id AS providerUserId FROM public.users WHERE email = #{email} LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO public.users(user_id, username, password, email, full_name, created_at, updated_at, avatar_url, auth_provider, provider_user_id) VALUES (#{userId}, #{userName}, #{password}, #{email}, #{fullName}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, #{avatarUrl}, #{authProvider}, #{providerUserId})

INSERT INTO public.users(user_id, username, password, email, full_name, updated_at, auth_provider, email_verified ) VALUES (#{userId}, #{userName}, #{password}, #{email}, #{fullName}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, #{authProvider}, true )

INSERT INTO public.users(user_id, username, password, email, full_name, status, created_at, updated_at, auth_provider, email_verified) VALUES (#{userId}, #{userName}, #{password}, #{email}, #{fullName}, 'ACTIVE', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, 'LOCAL', false)
mapper.update: UPDATE public.users SET email_verified = true, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE user_id = #{userId}
UPDATE public.users SET auth_provider = 'GOOGLE', provider_user_id = #{providerUserId}, full_name = #{fullName}, avatar_url = #{avatarUrl}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE user_id = #{userId}
mapper.select: UPDATE public.users SET status = #{status}, token_version = CASE WHEN #{status} = 'BANNED' OR #{status} = 'DELETED' THEN token_version + 1 ELSE token_version END WHERE user_id = #{userId} RETURNING status, token_version AS ver
SELECT u.user_id FROM users u INNER JOIN user_roles ur ON u.user_id = ur.user_id INNER JOIN roles r ON r.role_id = ur.role_id WHERE r.role_name = 'ROLE_ADMIN'
